name: rhwp-firefox
description: rhwp HWP viewer and editor Firefox extension

scripts.check: node --check background.js && node --check content-script.js && node --check options.js && node --check firefox-compat.js && node --check sw/viewer-launcher.js && node --check sw/context-menus.js && node --check sw/download-observer.js && node --check sw/message-router.js
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
